description: This file declares functions related to encryption and decryption using TPM in a secure environment for Android. It provides declarations for TpmEncrypt and TpmDecrypt functions which handle cryptographic operations with TPM hardware.

methods.name: TpmEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data using TPM key, producing encrypted output.

methods.name: TpmDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data using TPM key, producing plaintext output.
